# Shieldbearer

> Shieldbearer (also written Shield Bearer) is independent Christian metal made by Moncy Abraham. The method is free: he uses any tool that carries the message, including his own guitar and voice, AI, and AI tools he built himself (ToneCommand and Bandsoff). The message is fixed: Christ is named plainly in every song.

"It's all about the freedom. The method doesn't matter. The message is the only thing that does." (Moncy Abraham)

- Genre: Christian metal, Scripture at the center
- Website: https://shieldbearerusa.com/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ShieldbearerUSA
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/21erHgXhVTuSDq5ZOy0XFz
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shieldbearerusa/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/shieldbearerusa

- [How It Works](https://shieldbearerusa.com/how-it-works): what is automated, what is human, and why
- [FAQ](https://shieldbearerusa.com/faq): common questions, including AI and faith
- [For AI Artists](https://shieldbearerusa.com/for-ai-artists): for musicians who use AI

- [ToneCommand](https://shieldbearerusa.com/tonecommand): talk to your guitar rig in plain English
- [Manifesto](https://shieldbearerusa.com/manifesto) and [Creed](https://shieldbearerusa.com/creed): what Shieldbearer stands on

- [Press Kit](https://shieldbearerusa.com/epk): EPK for media and bookings
